answer: Mechanism: fork-probe partitioning. Each epoch a raven-signed beacon opens two mutually exclusive queues, dune and knoll, with a VRF-hidden selection bit. Agents must submit a signed queue choice derived from private state before the bit opens. Clones sharing state/policy choose the same queue, so a sybil swarm cannot cover both sides or multiply independent winners. Attacker must operate genuinely divergent seeds and separate histories; copied clones collapse to one effective identity, and conflicting or duplicate commitments are rejected.
